description: Manual entry-bar resolutions for signals without data_date whose entry bar cannot be matched by close alone (Decision #44). Read by outcomes_v2._entry_bar_ts. source is 'session_feasibility' (session rule + close) or 'run_timestamp' (hour of the signals.jsonl commit); never 'close_match'. Commit time is an upper bound of the run time.
session_rule: Entry bar must be the last session <= scan_date (post-close/weekend run) or the one before (pre-open run); only that set was considered.

evidence.rule: Commit before 11:00 ART = pre-open run: entry bar is the previous session (2026-09-10). 09-10 and 09-11 tie on close.

evidence.note: Weekend inference: a stale Thursday bar cannot be ruled out from data, only by the session rule.
